newsitem.title: USA: Federated Nov same-store sales rise 9.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Federated Nov same-store sales rise 9.6 pct.

text.p: Federated Department Stores, Inc said Thursday it had total sales of $1,552.3 million for the four weeks ended November 30, 1996, an increase of 3.8 percent from total sales of $1,495.4 million for the same four-week period last year.
On a comparable-store basis, Federated's November 1996 sales increased 9.6 percent.

It added that November 1995 total sales reflect revenue from all of the 82 Broadway Stores Inc, stores acquired by Federated last year, while total sales for November 1996 reflect only the revenues from those Broadway store properties that subsequently were converted to Federated nameplates - 56 stores as of November 30.

For the year to date, Federated reported total sales of $11,746.3 million, an increase of 4.1 percent over sales of $11,279.0 million in the same 43-week period last year. On a comparable-store basis, year-to-date sales increased 3.5 percent.
